session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit stuck, like I'm not making progress on anything. It's hard to stay motivated when I don't see a clear purpose in what I'm doing.
That sounds really frustrating. Maybe you could try breaking things down into smaller steps to feel more in control.
I don't know... I keep thinking, what's the point? If no one will ever see it, why bother?
It’s okay to feel that way. But maybe there’s something deeper that you’re not seeing. What would happen if you tried to focus on just one small thing right now?
I guess I could try... but I keep getting distracted. My mind just goes blank, and I feel like I'm wasting time.
It’s hard to stay focused when you’re feeling this way. Maybe you could try setting a timer for just five minutes and see what happens.
Five minutes? I don’t know if I can even do that. It feels like I’m forcing myself to do something I don’t want to.
You’re not forcing yourself—you’re choosing to take one small step. That’s a start, even if it feels uncomfortable.
I guess... I just don’t know where to begin. Everything feels too big, and I’m afraid I’ll fail again.
You don’t have to do it all at once. Let’s focus on just one thing that feels even slightly possible. What would that be?
Maybe... just opening the website file and adding one more section. It feels too small, but maybe that’s all I can do right now.
That’s a good start. Even small steps can build momentum over time. You’re doing better than you think.
Thanks... I guess. It still feels so hard, but maybe starting with that one thing is better than nothing.
You’re not giving yourself enough credit. You’re already making progress by recognizing that small step. Keep going.
I know... it’s just hard to believe I’m actually doing something, even if it’s tiny. I keep thinking I’ll just give up again.
You’re not alone in that fear. But every time you take a step, even a tiny one, you’re proving to yourself that you can keep going. That’s powerful.
Yeah... I guess that’s true. It’s just hard to remember when I’m feeling so stuck.
You’re not stuck forever. You’re just in a moment where it feels that way. And that’s okay. You’re allowed to feel stuck.
Yeah... I guess I am. It’s just hard to imagine getting out of this moment.
